games.name: Puppetria
games.description: A slightly unusual tea party in an old mansion. As you serve tea and sweets, teapots begin to dance and little ghosts appear... Your job is to quietly smooth over the mansion's lively welcome. Keep an eye on each new surprise and make sure the tea party stays elegant until the very end.

games.name: Cat Stack
games.description: Kidnapped by cats! In this frantic physics-based roguelite, your goal is to balance an endless tower of kitties on your head. Dash back and forth to keep your balance, survive chaotic events, and use special cats with unique powers to keep the stack from collapsing under its own weight.

games.name: Earthworks
games.description: Build your own earthmoving company! Buy trucks and excavators, compete for contracts, hire employees, manage your fleet, and grow your business. Overcome economic challenges, expand your operations, and build your construction empire in this 2D management simulation.

games.name: Hide & Chisel
games.description: Carve your body out of marble, and stand as still as a statue! Hide & Chisel is a hide-and-seek game where you carve a block of stone into any shape you can think of. Hide from the Curator and his hammer!

games.name: Popo and the Moonlit Shop
games.description: A magical shop simulator where you gather materials with your Popos, craft goods, and keep display stands full while fulfilling your customers' requests. Customise the shop to fit your aesthetic, and travel between worlds to open new branches of your Moonlit Shop!

games.name: Grandma's Button Shop
games.description: Grandma's button shop has gotten out of hand. Pick up the buttons scattered across her cozy old house and sort each one into its own labelled drawer, tray, tin or card. Unlock skills that light up, gather and auto-place buttons, and try your luck at the plinko board.

games.name: Sort My Money
games.description: Collect more than 46 currencies from around the world in this cozy organizing game! Sort 292 unique banknotes, arrange them by country and denomination, complete collections, and build your own museum of world money.

games.name: Let It Snow
games.description: Grab a shovel and dig into real, deformable snow. Clear your yard scoop by scoop, sell every load to the Snow-O-Matic, upgrade your tools and uncover what winter has buried. A cozy, satisfying snow-clearing sim.

games.name: A Place for Hue
games.description: A relaxing single-player sorting game where you restore 30 hand-crafted color gradients by finding the perfect spot for each piece! Pick up, sort and place over 6,000 mosaic pieces of all shapes and colors, earn money, unlock helpful upgrades, and watch your messy gallery slowly come to life!

games.name: Inn Kreeper
games.description: Run a spooky-cozy haunted inn as a broke lich, stress out your guests, trap them in rooms to turn them into ghost, and sell them online to rebuild your retro game collection.

games.name: NIGHT SHIFT: HAUNTED MALL
games.description: The mall closed at midnight. The ghosts didn't. 1–6 friends. 5 lost items. 1 date with Mika… and only one of you gets it. Frying pans, bazookas, banana peels: anything goes. And don't scream: the ghosts can hear your mic.

games.name: Duckload
games.description: 1,000,000 rubber ducks have been dumped deep in a mountain forest. Alone. Scared. Squeaky. Ship every last duck downstream for cash. Start with your bare hands and scale up across a massive upgrade tree to increase your duck harvesting power!

games.name: Dreams to Studio
games.description: Build your dream career from a small room to your own gaming empire! Create content, stream, develop games, upgrade your equipment and shape your future in an open-ended life and management simulation where every decision matters.

games.name: Dead Last
games.description: Dead Last is a horror party game for 2-8 friends where the monsters are only half the danger. Survive terrifying minigames, use items to save yourself and sabotage everyone else, and whatever you do, don't finish dead last.

games.name: Word War
games.description: Word War is a crossword strategy game for 1–4 players. Make words to capture star territories, then change a letter or two to steal your enemy's. Mind-game your friends with ambushes and flanks to hold the most territories before the time runs out!

games.name: PinDOS
games.description: Play your own copies of Epic Pinball, Silver Ball, Silver Ball 2 Plus and Extreme Pinball in a new front end: the whole table on one tall screen with no scrolling, 2-4 players online or on your home network, and a full virtual pinball cabinet mode. The games are not included.

games.name: COREDUMP: 口口口口
games.description: COREDUMP: 口口口口 is a Metroidvania inspired puzzle platformer where you recover lost colliders, switch between phasing through walls and charged bouncing, and uncover hidden paths across an interconnected world.

games.name: Flarebound
games.description: Tiny dungeon puzzle game. One flare. Ten steps. Draw a path through a forgotten dungeon before your light runs out. Avoid dangerous traps and evil creatures. 20 quests, 100 rooms.

games.name: Unknown Caller
games.description: The ghost never lies. Your friends do. Answer the phone, hear what she wants, then lie your way out of it. Mystery boxes, bombs, poisoned wine and terrible luck. 2-8 players with voice chat. Last one alive wins.

games.name: Snowman Left Behind
games.description: A cozy team snowball fight for up to eight friends. Build a snow fort, pelt the other team until they're snowmen, then hurry over to rescue your frozen friends. Twelve wintry maps, each with its own trick: sleds, toy trains, catapults, sheep and Grandma's cookies.

games.name: Drug Shop: Tidy Up Together
games.description: Talwer and Pesse finally went legit, but their shop is a disaster. A first-person sorting game for 1 to 4 players: put thousands of products on the right shelves, cook in the lab and stock the store, alone or in online co-op.

games.name: We Have a Robot Problem
games.description: Every robot in the vault has wandered off its charging rack. Catch them, stack them in your arms and put each one back in its own spot. Thousands of robots with hats and costumes, handy tools and a Workshop full of upgrades. A cosy, silly tidy up game.

games.name: Ah Sheep, Here We Go Again
games.description: An incremental game about a hungry flock that eats straight through the Earth, all the way to New Zealand. Sweep your cursor over the sheep and they bite the ground beneath them. Grow the flock, hire dogs and shepherds, and keep going down.

games.name: PAIN(T)
games.description: You have one job: paint the wall yellow. All of it. PAIN(T) is a co-op dystopian comedy for 1-4 colleagues sharing one shaky lift, with proximity voice chat. Whoever drives it ruins everyone's stroke. Buy bigger rollers, and try not to ask what the doors are for.

games.name: Crack the Crate
games.description: Crack the Crate is a super-satisfying crate-smashing incremental game. Open crates, collect 288 items and their rare variants, and upgrade your way from wooden boxes to cosmic crates. Can you find the legendary Dodo?

games.name: Taso Idle
games.description: Taso Idle is an incremental game where you flip tasos at recess and sell your stack for cash. Rip open snack packs for rare tasos, buy upgrades and leave the collecting to your little brothers. The bullies can take everything but your name. Start with a bottle cap, become the Schoolyard Legend.

games.name: Incremon
games.description: Build a thriving farm powered by Incremons! Capture roaming pets, evolve them, and keep them well-fed. Harvest, stockpile, and manage resources to unlock upgrades and expand your farm in this cozy incremental game.

games.name: An incremental city from a word search: Wordhood
games.description: Build an incremental town powered by word searches. Wordhood is an addictive blend of finding words and watching numbers grow. Gather resources, combine upgrades, and unleash combos to grow a hungry town.

games.name: Cook & Sail
games.description: A 1-4 player co-op restaurant that happens to be a ship. Work the day as a crew, keep hungry customers from walking out, and spend what you make on a vessel that can actually handle the job. The tables want a good meal. The fleet wants its share.

games.name: FATHOM
games.description: Send your crew deep into an alien ocean in this pixel-art desktop companion idler. Research strange creatures, harvest and refine resources, expand your deep-sea research platform, and discover the secrets lurking beneath the waves.

games.name: Oceanarium Fishing
games.description: Fish, explore and survive in a co-op horror adventure for 1–4 players. Brave the ocean, upgrade your boat and build your aquarium. But save enough of your catch to feed the island’s Keeper: its daily quota is growing, and the water hides more than fish.

games.name: Compicactus
games.description: Compi is a little cactus on your windowsill, and it wants to keep a diary. Help it write about your days with a few taps: the people you love, what you did and how you felt. Watch it grow and bloom, dress it up, and read your days as Compi saw them.

games.name: Fantasy Guild Manager
games.description: Your heroes handle the fighting. Everything else is your problem. Recruit and level up adventurers, send them into auto-battles before quest timers run out, and grow your Guild Town in real time while Chaos creeps across the land.

games.name: 9 Box
games.description: Ten players. Nine boxes. Grab a box, pick one of two abilities, take aim — then every ability fires at the same moment. Fast, chaotic online battles for up to 10 toys in a giant kid's bedroom. Matches last under 5 minutes.

games.name: Haunted! But Sorted.
games.description: It's 1996. Wojak needs money, and his girlfriend Dodoo is counting on him. His job: the night shift at a shop in the middle of a graveyard. Haul in deliveries, sort every product and keep one eye on the dark. Play solo or co-op, but don't go outside alone.

games.name: Mad Scientist Simulator – Society of World Destruction
games.description: Run a mad science shop by day, pilot a giant robot by night. In this 1-4 player co-op comedy sim you stock shelves, brew unstable potions and expose undercover agents - then split the robot's controls with your friends to flatten 5 cities and beat 5 superheroes.

games.name: Desktop Reimu
games.description: Desktop Reimu is a Touhou Project fan-made idle game that sits along the bottom edge of your screen. Your key presses and clicks turn into donations while you work, and Reimu heads out to resolve incidents.

games.name: ZOO CATCHER / SUNSHARD FARM
games.description: A two-game indie collection featuring ZOO CATCHER, a keyboard typing game, and SUNSHARD FARM, a farming adventure with real-time combat. Enjoy two different ways to play in one collection.

games.name: SlotsNStocks
games.description: Rig the market in this deckbuilding slot machine roguelite. Draft hundreds of bullish and bearish symbols, build money-making combinations, and manipulate the odds in your favor. Adapt to an ever-shifting market and make enough to survive your next margin call.

games.name: Paradice Run Club
games.description: Roll dice, gather resources, and hit the target! Paradice Run Club is a precision strategy roguelike where players get as close as possible to a target number. Compete with other runners or against your own records to follow those targets as they climb from 17, to 21, to 100!

games.name: Überlauf
games.description: Build a mine with cards on a freshly rolled voxel island: place mines, lay belts, smelt ore into ingots. You get 75 seconds per round. Then your jokers multiply the takings until the number catches fire. A roguelike blend of factory building and cards.

games.name: Gun Party
games.description: Roll for stars. Sabotage your friends. Gun Party packs 5 boards and 79 mini-games into one chaotic party night, from cart crashes to crew disasters and horror rounds. Play with 2–10 online or up to 4 in couch split-screen. Full controller support. Add bots to any match.

games.name: SERPENTER
games.description: A fast, colorful 3D snake adventure across 9 floating worlds and 63 levels! Dodge crumbling floors, slippery ice and wild hazards, unleash power-ups, tackle endless runs and daily challenges, or play with up to 4 friends. Help Zip find Ray!

games.name: Pimple Pop
games.description: Get up close. Really, really close. Squeeze pimples, scrape plaque, roll out earwax, pluck nose hairs and trim nails in 21 levels of ultra-detailed close-up work. Be gentle, be precise, and never touch the eardrum. Earn 3 stars on every level and unlock them all.

games.name: Hair Stylist Simulator
games.description: Every client brings a photo. Match it with your scissors and clippers before time runs out, then shampoo, blow-dry and sweep up. Run your own salon, cut 8 different styles for 8 clients, and earn five stars. Cut too much and you can't put it back!

games.name: Switchroom
games.description: You were naughty this year. Now you're stuck in Santa's warehouse with your friends. Every switch might drop a toy, kill the lights or let something in. Find the toys on the list, ship them, and survive each other.

games.name: Gnome Cottage Cleanup!
games.description: A whimsical organizing simulator about tracking down thousands of Gnomes, Plants, Books, Potions and more! Use magical abilities and upgrades on your quest to sort 4,060 items scattered across the Gnome Cottage. Just pure exploration, organizing, and collecting with no time limits or pressure.

games.name: A Game About Feeding Pigeons
games.description: Relax and build the ultimate pigeon sanctuary! Start with basic crumbs, scatter seed, and attract dozens of unique birds. Upgrade your feed, unlock automated machines, and discover beautiful new locations in this cozy idle incremental game.

games.name: Bet Your Friends
games.description: Shocking twist on Monopoly, your FRIENDS now become your prized ASSETS! BUY, WORK, BID or GAMBLE. First one to REACH $1,000,000 WINS! Have YOU ever bet with your FRIEND'S LIFE on the line?

games.name: Gravity well
games.description: Explore vast galaxies through gravity wells and realistic physics. Launch and combine celestial bodies to uncover mysterious stories hidden in space. Race friends and players worldwide for the top spot, or slow down and enjoy a tranquil deep-space atmosphere beneath the stars.

games.name: Flag Boom! Chronicles
games.description: Plant your flag on a fort and your WHOLE ARMY DOUBLES! A pixel-art RTS where hundreds of archers, spearmen and cavalry clash in a rock-paper-scissors war. Pick a unit type, march, seize forts and watch your army explode. 20 stages, 4 giant bosses.

games.name: Corner Club
games.description: A tiny pixel nightclub living in the corner of your desktop. Put on any music and the dancers move on its beat!

games.name: Her in the Abyss
games.description: You accidentally intercept a distress signal from space—a girl codenamed C804 is venturing alone into a forbidden zone. Game time runs in perfect real-time sync with reality; every response, every silence, shapes her actions and decisions.

games.name: Zoo Life Tycoon
games.description: Inherit a run-down zoo at the edge of town and turn it into the pride of the city. Repair pens, care for 21 species, welcome families and juggle your own life too: eat, sleep, make friends and upgrade your home in this cozy pixel-art zoo tycoon and life sim.

games.name: Carry Crew
games.description: “We can fit one more!” Pick your cargo, stack it high, and grab opposite ends of the board in this physics-based co-op delivery game for two. Match your steps as the rope bridge sways. The finish line is in sight, and the top box just started to slide.

games.name: Pinball Bonanza Live
games.description: Run a live stream from your garage and build a seven-floor pinball machine with your viewers’ donations. Flip, nudge and chase multiball while chat cheers you on — then automate it all in a hands-on incremental pinball game.

games.name: Stay Lit
games.description: You're the last ember. He's the jerk who blew out the rest. Roll through 130 trap-packed levels in 26 worlds while Snuff, a shadow imp, rigs each level right in front of you and takes notes on how you play, so the level changes after you die.

games.name: Why Does the Ball Fall?
games.description: An idle and clicker game about dropping balls, over and over. Hit a goal hole and the ball rolls one lane deeper; miss and it is gone. Spend coins to seal holes, widen the goals and unlock fruit and animal balls, then keep descending lanes that go on forever.

games.name: Bottom Feeders: Crab Crew
games.description: Haul up crab pots with 1–6 friends in this silly co-op crabbing game. Throw pots off the pier, pull up 37 kinds of ridiculous crabs, sell them, and trade your leaky rowboat for a solid gold yacht. Or just shove your crew into the sea.

games.name: Paint The Wall
games.description: 400 meters of bare concrete. Out you go! Paint the Wall is a satisfying painting sim where the higher you climb, the more you earn. Upgrade to paint cannons and hot air balloons, hire robots and drones, and paint it all, solo or with friends. That wall won't paint itself!
